messages:
maya: Heads up — release window blocked. Deploy-bot failed to promote canary; one parallel CI matrix job (integration/worker-7) is stuck at test step for 12m, failing to finish due to cache checksum mismatch on artifact fetch. Deploy-bot posted error: `artifact checksum mismatch`.
alex: logs?
sam: any idea if it's a single shard or systemic?
maya: pasted logs:
```text
fetching cache shard s3://ci-cache/sha/abcd1234
expected: 0x9f2c got: 0x3a7b
error: checksum mismatch, aborting
```
sam: Uh, that sounds like the prefetch read returned a corrupted object. Is this a single shard? Can we re-run that job?
maya: It's happening in 3/3 retries, and deploy-bot flagged the promotion as FAILED. Change window ends in 45m. We need a decision: pin to last-good image (manual promote) or requeue/force rerun of the stuck matrix job.
jen: Manual pin means we lose canary changes; do we have a known-good digest?
alex: Yes — image digest sha256:deadbeef is last canary green. Manual promote via deploy-bot CLI: `deploybot promote --image sha256:deadbeef --reason 'ci cache corrupt'`
ci-runner-bot: requeue attempt 1 scheduled by @alex: `buildkite-agent build requeue --job integration/worker-7`
maya: Requeue already attempted once by CI, failed with same checksum. Suggest we investigate cache store briefly: ops, any known S3 issue?
sam: Not seeing S3 errors. Might be a local cache shard corruption on the runner pool. Quick mitigation: re-run only the failed axis on a different pool: `pipeline: integration { agent_pool: 'runner-warm' }` — cheaper than full rollback.
jen: If we re-run on a different pool we can still promote if green. If it fails again, we should manual promote to last-good.
maya: Decision: try targeted requeue to runner-warm (5m). If green, proceed with promote. If fails, manual promote to sha256:deadbeef. I will open a release-notes note about rollback fallback.
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked. Awaiting manual action. :warning:
maya: I'll trigger requeue now and put a pin hold ready.
alex: Thanks — copying release leads. @marketing FYI — release window may slip up to 1 hour.
maya: Requeue sent. Monitoring...
ci-runner-bot: job integration/worker-7 restarted on runner-warm (id rw-72)
maya: job passed — logs show artifact fetched OK. Proceeding to promote canary.
deploy-bot: Promotion succeeded. Release window clear. :tada:
